Players Committee card image of [[You Know What I've Come For (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “USED: Use 1 Force to take a [First Order] shuttle into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: Deploy Jakku: Landing Site, Bow To The First Order, and one Effect that deploys on table and is always immune to Alter. Place this Interrupt in hand.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/youknowwhativecomefor.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6d7b3a40f529171f7399cff382887d6260118998 6d7b3a4] (9 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
